company.name: Claire
company.shortDescription: Claire is a chatbot for testing consumer products, helping brands and retailers identify best-sellers and worst performers pre-production.
company.description:
Claire is a Facebook Messenger bot for testing consumer products that helps brands and retailers identify best and worst performers pre-production. It also helps businesses optimize products and ad campaigns through surveys. 

The bot sends an email to the customers with a link to chat and consumers are rewarded with loyalty points and giveaways from its users’ brand. Claire analyzes their interactions to deliver accurate insights.

Claire is a U.S.-based company that was founded in 2015 by Marta Jamrozik and Misha Laskin.
